title: CairnSessionFinding
description: Per-session distillation finding. One document per session at findings/<session_id>.findings.json. Conforms to §2.4 of SPEC_HIVE_CONTEXT_SESSIONS_00_PROGRAM.

session_id.description: UUID of the distilled session (matches the envelope's session.id).

distilled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this finding was written.

distiller.description: Tool or skill that produced this finding, plus version tag. E.g. 'session_distill@ws09'.

harness.description: Harness the session came from (claude-code, pi, antigravity, or unknown).

patterns.description: Patterns observed (or seeded from prior ledger) in this session.

instance_count.description: Number of times this pattern appeared. 0 = seeded from prior ledger but not observed this session.

evidence.description: Line range (e.g. 'L42-L89'), event seq range (e.g. 'seq:12-15'), or provenance tag.

candidates.description: Promotion candidates surfaced from this session.

skills.description: Skill names that could be refined or created.

laws.description: Law slugs that should be promoted or reinforced.

memory.description: Memory entry names suggested for promotion.

note.description: Path to a related /note file, or null.

commit.description: Git commit hash if these findings were applied, or null.
